## ✅ Security fix for the font-cache write

I tightened the cache path in [docs/scripts/lib/og-fonts.ts](docs/scripts/lib/og-fonts.ts) so it only accepts bytes that look like a real TTF/OTF font before writing them to disk, and it also rejects invalid cached bytes on read.

What changed:
- Added a strict font-header check before writing downloaded data to the local cache
- Reused that same validation when reading cached files, so malformed or unexpected payloads are discarded
- Added a regression test in [docs/scripts/lib/og-fonts.test.ts](docs/scripts/lib/og-fonts.test.ts) covering:
  - valid font headers pass
  - arbitrary network data is rejected

## Verification

I verified with this command:

- vp test docs/scripts/lib/og-fonts.test.ts

Fresh result:
- 1 test file passed
- 2 tests passed
- exit status successful

This closes the file-write risk described by the Snyk finding without changing the intended font download behavior.
